text:
oliver (PM): Quick sync — planning to roll the new "visibility shim" for the Settings panel as a hidden/default-off UI flag. Need a short canary plan + guardrails before I ship the rollout note.

maria (SWE): Ack. backend flag is ui.visibility_shim (boolean). We'll gate by user attribute 'beta_spaces' for canary. Backend change PR in flight: https://git.internal/r/redwood/flag-service/pulls/312

jon (SWE): Can you paste the exact rollout steps? I want to add the console toggle hook in the frontend PR.

maria (SWE): Plan draft:
1) Deploy backend flag as OFF by default.
2) Enable for 5% of accounts where account.metadata.beta_spaces = true (internal canary group).
3) After 48h, if error rate < 1% and 95th latency < 400ms for settings load, expand to 25%.
4) After 72h more, expand to 100% if metrics look good.

kai (SRE): Add auto-disable guardrail: if Settings API 5xx rate > 1.5% for the canary cohort OR p95 latency > 600ms for 30m, flip flag back off and page oncall. I can wire a Datadog monitor.

ashley (Design): For the hidden UX, we'll show the new control only when flag=true. In the UI we should include a subtle "Beta" pill and a tooltip: "Hidden feature available to selected accounts." No change to global nav. I'll attach assets.

jon (SWE): Frontend PR ready, needs the exact flag key and the admin toggle path. I will add a hidden-settings route so support can toggle per-account.

maria (SWE): Backend config snippet (for ops):
```yaml
feature_flags:
  ui.visibility_shim:
    default: false
    rollout:
      - cohort: beta_spaces_users
        percent: 5
        start: 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z
      - cohort: beta_spaces_users
        percent: 25
        start: 2026-03-20T16:00:00Z
    guardrails:
      error_rate_threshold: 0.015  # 1.5%
      latency_p95_threshold_ms: 600
```

oliver (PM): Nice. Add a comms line: "Support: how to opt-in/out" and a short playbook for rolling back. Also we should mark this flag as hidden (not exposed in self-serve) until full launch.

ashley (Design): For the tooltip copy suggestion: "This is an experimental setting available to a limited group. Contact support to request access." Keeping it short.

kai (SRE): I set up the monitor draft: Datadog monitors for canary cohort: 
- settings.api.errors(canary) > 1.5% over 30m
- settings.api.p95_latency(canary) > 600ms over 30m
If triggered, automatic remediation script will toggle flag=false and create a PagerDuty incident.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary toggle for ui.visibility_shim at 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z (5% cohort).

sre-bot: monitor created: dd_monitor_4491 (Settings API canary error rate). Alerting to #oncall and pager.

maria (SWE): One more ask — QA needs a test account in the canary group and a flag override REST endpoint for manual testing. I'm adding a dev-only endpoint: POST /flags/override {flag, account_id, value}.

jon (SWE): LGTM, will wire the frontend to respect override endpoint for dev/testing only. Ping me for code review: @jon.

oliver (PM): Timeline: ship backend change today, frontend hidden toggle PR by EOD, design assets posted in Figma by morning, canary starts Thu 16:00 UTC. I'll draft the rollout note and support playbook after lunch. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ashley (Design): small note — can we show an admin-only badge when support views account settings to indicate the hidden flag is active? If so, I’ll add designs.

kai (SRE): yes, add an admin badge in UI. We'll also log flag toggles to audit logs for compliance.

maria (SWE): merging backend PR now. Will post the deploy link + PR hash in this thread once completed.

deploy-bot: deploy started: sha=af3b2c7 to service=flag-service/stable

maria (SWE): merged and deployed. sha=af3b2c7. Can confirm feature_flags ui.visibility_shim exists and default=false in prod config.

oliver (PM): Perfect. I'll close out with a short checklist in the release notes and tag support + docs. Follow-up in #support when the canary runs.

jon (SWE): Reviewing frontend PR now, should be up in the next hour.

sre-bot: reminder: canary evaluation window starts 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z — automated checks will run at +30m, +2h, +24h.

oliver (PM): Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for status.
